The Railway Motel, Norseman, Western Australia, Accommodation, Hotel, Motel, Backpackers
Main Content
Welcoming accommodation in Norseman, Western Australia
The Railway Motel and Deco Guesthouse is a charming old hotel built in the art deco style that is being slowly restored to its former glory. We provide a relaxed, comfortable and welcoming environment for overnight and short term stays. In addition to the hotel rooms with modern spa bathrooms, there are simple ensuite Motel cabins adjacent to the old hotel (some of which are pet friendly).
email or phone to book
therailway@iinet.net.au or 08 90390003
A GEM IN THE MIDST OF A MINING COMMUNITY - STYLISH, COMFORTABLE, HERITAGE COMBINED
"The only place to stay in Norseman in our opinion. Therese, the lovely Owner/Manager, warmly greeted us on arrival. This is a refurbished Australian art deco former luxury hotel, stylishly decorated with art, oriental carpets, and interesting furnishings. Our room (#15) in the original hotel was excellent - every amenity of a 5-star hotel was provided. Exceptionally clean. Very comfortable bed with beautifully laundered linens and superb pillows - all greatly appreciated after our 800kms drive from Perth. Oh and beautiful hot water. A self-serve continental breakfast is included - every coffee option, every cereal and milk option, and a good range of toast and condiments. As we were there in winter, it was a joy to come home from dinner to fireplaces alight. We cannot fault The Railway Hotel & Woodlands Guesthouse which is full of charm and character - a gem in what is essentially a mining town. Thank you for a relaxing and wonderful stay. We look forward to re-visiting." Trip Advisor August 2024.
YOGA
The Railway Motel & Woodlands Guesthouse holds weekly yoga classes and occasional workshops and retreats. Enjoy a yoga class as you are passing through - in the heart of the Great Western Woodlands.
WILDERNESS WALKS
Norseman lies at the heart of the Great Western Woodlands, the largest intact area of Mediterranean woodlands in the world and a bio diversity hotspot. The Railway Motel & Woodlands Guesthouse is the ideal base from which to explore this great pristine wilderness.
NORSEMAN
Norseman is a town on the Coolgardie-Esperance Highway, Western Australia with a rich history and fluctuating fortunes. It is an ideal place to break the East/West journey or to explore an interesting town and fascinating environment.
HISTORY
The Railway Hotel was built in 1939 by two Kalgoorlie publicans who were flush with cash and obviously feeling adventurous. The design is a very Australian version of the art deco style, which every attempt is made to enhance and conserve.
